title: Phawar of the Twenty-Five Years (Arphew San Snem)
cultural_context: Jubilee phawar celebrating a quarter-century of statehood, cultural revival, and linguistic preservation, from 'Ka Phawar Beh Sbai'.

khasi: Hoi-kiw! Arphew san snem ki la leit noh,
Naduh ba ngi ioh la ka ri;
Ki lum ki wah ki risaw da ka kmen,
Ha kane ka sngi ba phyrnai;
Ngi kynmaw ia ki kpa ba la trei,
Ki la buh ia ka nongrim ba skhem
Ba ka ri kan kiew sha khmat.
english: Hoi-kiw! Five and twenty years have marched by,
Since our statehood was won in peace;
The crags and rivers ring out with jubilation,
We remember the leaders who labored selflessly,
To secure our regional autonomy and liberty;
They established a firm and enduring rock
For our motherland to march boldly forward.

khasi: Phawar, ko samla, phawar da ka kmen,
Wat klet ia la ka ktien tynrai;
Ka ktien dei ka mynsiem ka jaidbynriew,
Ba pynneh ia ka burom baroh;
Ha ki arphew san snem ba dang wan,
Ngin iatylli ha kawei ka nia,
Ban pynriewspah ia ka ri Khasi
Ha ka hok bad ka jingshisha.
english: Chant your phawar, youths, chant with glad hearts,
For language is the living soul of a people,
Preserving its dignity throughout the ages;
In the five and twenty years that lie ahead,
We shall stand united in one righteous cause,
To enrich our beloved Khasi land
